request_body.raw_goal: Expand my business into a second product line.
request_body.user_context: Runs wholesale textile trading, Kano. No fixed schedule — market days and travel vary week to week. High impact goal, about 5 months out. First time using an app like this. Does not want long conversations, wants useful output fast.

objectives: Identify high-demand product opportunities within the wholesale textile market suitable for inventory expansion.
Verify supply chain feasibility, including sourcing, quality assurance, and landed cost analysis for new textile categories.
Establish logistics protocols for storage, handling, and distribution of the new product line.
Formulate a go-to-market plan that leverages existing customer relationships and distribution channels.
Complete initial trial procurement to validate inventory turnover and margin assumptions.

proposed_milestones.description: Conduct market research to identify specific textile products that align with current wholesale trading margins and volume demand.
objectives: Review historical sales data and current inventory movement to identify product gaps.
Interview key wholesale clients to gauge interest in potential new textile categories.
Analyze competitor offerings and pricing structures within the local Kano market.

proposed_milestones.description: Source and vet suppliers for the new product line, focusing on quality certification and wholesale price negotiation.
objectives: Request and compare product samples against established quality standards.
Perform landed cost analysis factoring in freight, duties, and handling requirements.
Audit potential supplier capacity to fulfill bulk orders according to your standard lead times.

proposed_milestones.description: Design an operational workflow for the integration of the new product line into your existing warehouse and distribution system.
objectives: Update inventory management systems to categorize the new products.
Establish new standard operating procedures for the receiving, storage, and handling of the new inventory.
Coordinate storage space allocation to ensure existing stock remains organized during expansion.

proposed_milestones.description: Execute a limited pilot launch to test market uptake and refine distribution logistics.
objectives: Place an initial small-batch purchase order for the new product category.
Implement a targeted sales push to a pre-identified set of reliable wholesale clients.
Track inventory turnover rate and gross margins for the pilot period to determine viability for scale.

success_metrics: Completion of a finalized supplier contract for the secondary product line.
Successful arrival and quality inspection of the first pilot procurement batch.
Achievement of a 90% sell-through rate on pilot inventory within the first 60 days post-launch.
Establishment of a standardized unit-cost and retail-price matrix for the new line.

request_body.raw_goal: Prepare for a trade show in 3 weeks. Need samples, pricing sheets, contacts.
request_body.user_context: Specific trade show, hard 3-week deadline. High business stakes — this is a direct revenue opportunity. Still has the product-line expansion goal active.

objectives: Curate and finalize a physical trade show sample kit representing the current product line.
Develop and print professional-grade pricing collateral tailored to trade show procurement cycles.
Establish a systematized workflow for capturing and qualifying lead data during the event.
Refine the logistical and promotional preparation to ensure booth readiness for the 3-week deadline.

proposed_milestones.description: Finalize product assortment and assemble physical exhibition samples.
objectives: Select product SKUs for display based on market appeal and margin profile.
Quality-check physical units for exhibition-grade presentation.
Create inventory manifest and packing list for booth materials.

proposed_milestones.description: Draft, design, and finalize sales collateral and pricing structures.
objectives: Calculate tiered pricing sheets incorporating volume discounts and lead-time estimates.
Design visual product data sheets for high-impact attendee engagement.
Coordinate high-resolution printing and finishing of all physical handouts.

proposed_milestones.description: Establish lead capture infrastructure and booth operations plan.
objectives: Configure digital lead retrieval tools or physical CRM intake templates.
Develop an elevator pitch script and qualification criteria for incoming leads.
Perform a final cross-check of booth logistics, shipping status, and onsite supplies.

success_metrics: Physical sample kits and promotional materials received and inventoried 48 hours prior to the show date.
Pricing sheets finalized, printed, and approved by stakeholders for distribution.
Lead capture system tested and integrated into the primary CRM pipeline.
Booth equipment checklist verified and signed off for transit or onsite delivery.
